name: Geostationary Imager Native Tile Source Node
description: Request-builder flow nodes of the native-tile lane (typed contracts 1.0): the hour's first full-disk scan of each wanted GOES ABI L1b/L2 product in NOAA Open Data Dissemination's anonymous public buckets, listed, chosen and fetched (byte ranges above imager_max_part_bytes, one part an invocation) for imager-native-tile-parser (level-5 tiles, source <bucket>-tiles5), and the dataset-publication POST of each stored batch. plan turns a TimerTick into one S3 ListObjectsV2 HttpRequest (HREQ) per (satellite, product folder) of the frame hour, its list job in HREQ.CONTEXT as a size-prefixed $WXF header record (FIELD_ID the wanted fields, SENSOR_ID, DATASET_ID the bucket, SOURCE_URL the folder prefix, VALID_TIME_MS the frame hour); select_files takes the listing HttpResponses (HRSP, the job echoed in CONTEXT) and emits, for each wanted field, the hour's first full-disk scan as GET HttpRequests - byte ranges when a file is larger than imager_max_part_bytes, each response well under the host's 100 MiB cap - each part's file job in CONTEXT as a $WXF header record (FIELD_ID the field, VARIABLE_NAME the NetCDF variable, SENSOR_ID, DATASET_ID, SOURCE_URL, ORIGIN_ID, LICENSE_CLASS, LICENSE_URL, CITATION, VALID_TIME_MS, TILE_INDEX/TILE_COUNT the part), ONE FILE PER INVOCATION, yielding the rest as backlog so the parser holds one file and storage-ingest receives one meta and one record stream at a time; publish_request turns a stored IngestResult (INGR) plus the parser's IngestRequest (INGQ) into the dataset-publication POST for the node's loopback admin endpoint (nothing when imager_publish_url is unset or the batch was refused). Every GET sets if-modified-since at the epoch so the host never turns a repeat listing or a second byte range into an empty 304. Skips and missing files are FlowNotices (FNTC). Node CONFIG through plugin.getConfig (SDS $PIV, one ModuleConfig on raw "config"): imager_live_access (default true), imager_satellites, imager_fields (default the five the world-clouds display reads), imager_frame_time (default the latest hour imager_lag_minutes old), imager_max_part_bytes, timeouts, imager_publish_url; imager_widths is read by the parser. The publication POST's BODY an IngestResult (INGR) FlatBuffer naming the stored batch (SCHEMA, PROVIDER_ID, SOURCE_NAME, BATCH_ID, INSERTED / RECONCILED_* counts, ARCHIVED), content-type application/octet-stream, as data-source/nwp-field-source posts it., carried verbatim in HREQ.BODY. No credentials: capabilities none.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method turns its typed frames into HttpRequest frames in one pass: plan reads the node config once and emits listing requests, select_files parses the listings and queues one entry per file, publish_request pairs one result with one meta. The only state is select_files's queue of pending files, drained one per invocation as the compiled runtime resumes the yielded node; no worker pool and no thread.

methods.description: TimerTick -> one S3 ListObjectsV2 HttpRequest per (satellite, product folder) of the frame hour, its list job (satellite's sensor and bucket, folder prefix, frame time, wanted fields) in CONTEXT; one Skipped FlowNotice when live access is off. One tick per invocation (a surplus is refused as batched-input-frames).

acceptedTypeSets.description: TimerTick (module-sdk runtime type TICK); its payload is not read.
HttpRequest (HREQ): GET of the S3 ListObjectsV2 URL, header if-modified-since at the epoch, TIMEOUT_MS imager_list_timeout_ms; CONTEXT the list job, a size-prefixed $WXF header record.

outputPorts.description: One listing request per (satellite, product folder), its list job in CONTEXT.
Why a cycle emitted nothing: Skipped (REASON live-access-disabled or nothing-to-list).

methods.description: Listing HttpResponses (each with its list job in CONTEXT) -> for each wanted field the hour's first full-disk scan (scan stamp _s<YYYY><DDD><HH>0, band -M<n>C<band>_ for imagery) as GET HttpRequests, byte ranges when the listed size exceeds imager_max_part_bytes, each part's file job in CONTEXT. One file per invocation; the node yields with the rest as backlog and the runtime resumes it without input. Missing files and failed listings (STATUS other than 200) are one Missing FlowNotice.

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (HRSP): STATUS, the ListObjectsV2 XML BODY, the list job echoed in CONTEXT.

inputPorts.description: The listing responses, each echoing its list job in CONTEXT; any number per invocation.

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpRequest (HREQ): GET of the object, headers if-modified-since at the epoch and range when parted, TIMEOUT_MS imager_file_timeout_ms; CONTEXT the file job, a size-prefixed $WXF header record.

outputPorts.description: The GET request(s) of one file (one per byte-range part), each with its file job in CONTEXT.
Which files the listings lacked and which listings failed: one Missing notice (COUNT, ITEMS).

methods.description: A stored IngestResult + the parser's IngestRequest -> one dataset-publication POST (BODY an IngestResult (INGR) FlatBuffer naming the stored batch (SCHEMA, PROVIDER_ID, SOURCE_NAME, BATCH_ID, INSERTED / RECONCILED_* counts, ARCHIVED), content-type application/octet-stream, as data-source/nwp-field-source posts it) to imager_publish_url; nothing when it is unset or the result is REFUSED. One pair per invocation.

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestResult (INGR): SCHEMA, BATCH_ID; REFUSED when nothing was stored.

inputPorts.description: The parser's ingest request (the carrier of provider and source).

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpRequest (HREQ): POST to imager_publish_url, BODY an IngestResult (INGR) FlatBuffer naming the stored batch (SCHEMA, PROVIDER_ID, SOURCE_NAME, BATCH_ID, INSERTED / RECONCILED_* counts, ARCHIVED), content-type application/octet-stream, as data-source/nwp-field-source posts it.
